notes.title: Stability patch
notes.content: Should fix issue with the screen turning completely white for some players.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Update
notes.content:
Check out the latest Tiny Terrariums update during Steam Next Fest!

New digging tools
- Ground painting with different materials.
- Flatten tool.
- Smoothing tool.

Improved AI
- Gnomes will now bounce on mushrooms to jump up on nearby ledges.
- Gnomes can get themselves unstuck better than before.

And a few more things
- Added new wooden cup decoration.
- Added control tutorial messages.

notes.title: Lens flares and bugfixes!
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Added lens flares. Shiny!
- Increased minimum duration of Tomte jump.
- Camera can no longer be turned upside-down.
- Pole Lantern no longer detects its own lantern during placement.
- Terrarium, decoration, sky, and fog settings are now reset move cleanly when creating a new terrarium. This should give you a proper clean slate when creating a new terrarium.

notes.title: Music!
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Added music.
- Added audio settings.
- Made settings menu reachable from the pause menu.
- Added value display to the side of sliders.
- Remapped the values of the Sun Intensity slider to make it easier to fine-tune. You may have to adjust the sun intensity in your existing terrariums.

notes.title: UI Scaling Bugfixes
notes.content:
Patch notes

- Improved UI scaling across most common aspect ratios. Non-16:9 aspect ratios should now work much better.
- When creating a new terrarium, names with spaces are now also checked properly to avoid creating a terrarium with a name that's already used by another terrarium.
- Fixed a bug that caused the New Terrarium button in the main menu to sometimes only be clickable on the bottom half.

notes.title: Bricks Update!
notes.content: Added brick walls and blocks for you to build with. Let me know if there are other shapes or sizes that you'd like!
